decisions.reason: Accumulated sunk costs and the public launch of the fifteen-day express program reinforce persistence, reducing the likelihood of withdrawal.
Although the seventy-two-hour express program has lower public visibility, its operational commitments and sunk costs still make persistence likely.
The express delivery product line's dedicated website presence and multiple models represent substantial sunk investment and public commitment that strongly favor continuation.
As a central, highly visible digital services platform aligned with the firm's strategic direction, accumulated investment and announced commitment make withdrawal very unlikely.
The fire and smoke protection door embodies invested development and safety expertise, and although its public visibility is lower, sunk costs favor persistence.
